title: Associate Director, Client Services
jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a sharp, digitally native Director to lead a high-priority, dedicated client mandate at Mindshare. The account sits in the BFSI category, specifically within the stock broking and investment space, one of India's most competitive and fast-evolving digital advertising categories. The ideal candidate brings deep BFSI category knowledge, strong hands-on digital branding expertise, and the ability to drive full-funnel media thinking while managing senior client relationships with confidence and precision.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Role at a Glance</strong></p> <table width="624"> <tbody> <tr> <td width="187"> <p><strong>Reporting To</strong></p> </td> <td width="437"> <p>Client Lead, Mindshare</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="187"> <p><strong>Category Focus</strong></p> </td> <td width="437"> <p>BFSI (Stock Broking / Investment / Fintech)</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="187"> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> </td> <td width="437"> <p>Mumbai</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="187"> <p><strong>Experience Required</strong></p> </td> <td width="437"> <p>6-10 years (Media Agency preferred)</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="187"> <p><strong>Role Type</strong></p> </td> <td width="437"> <p>Full-Time | Dedicated Single-Client Mandate</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <p><strong>In 3 Months</strong></p> <ul> <li>Thorough understanding of the client's business: KPIs, user acquisition goals, category dynamics, and competitive context</li> <li>Proficient in account processes, internal tools, and Mindshare x Xaxis workflows</li> <li>Delivering high-quality, responsive output on day-to-day client requests with minimal escalation</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>In 6 Months</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep knowledge of the BFSI digital media landscape, including competitive spend patterns across key category players</li> <li>Established relationships with key digital media owners and platforms relevant to financial services</li> <li>Embedded into specialist teams (Xaxis, Strategy, Business Science) with a clear collaborative rhythm</li> <li>Recognized by the client as the senior daily contact, making proactive contributions to planning sessions</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>In 12 Months</strong></p> <ul> <li>Consulting with the client on business outcomes, not just media delivery</li> <li>Leading all planning responses end-to-end: from insight to strategy to execution</li> <li>Driving incremental revenue opportunities and supporting scope and fee conversations</li> <li>Providing structured feedback and development guidance to junior team members</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Day-to-Day Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and manage the account as the primary Mindshare point of contact for the client</li> <li>Lead digital media strategy and planning across branding and performance mandates</li> <li>Build and review media plans across OLV, CTV, Programmatic, Social, SEM, and Hyperlocal channels</li> <li>Benchmark costs across partners and ensure plans are competitively priced and well-justified</li> <li>Manage the Xaxis relationship for programmatic planning and execution, maintaining SLAs and quality standards</li> <li>Track competitive media activity in the category and bring intelligence into client conversations</li> <li>Attend and lead client meetings, internal reviews, and partner discussions</li> <li>Translate client briefs into structured, insight-led media solutions</li> <li>Coordinate with specialist teams (Strategy, Business Science, Content) for integrated deliverables</li> <li>Support award entries, case study development, and thought leadership as needed</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Must-Have Requirements</strong></p> <p><strong>Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>6-10 years of media agency experience, with a significant portion in digital media</li> <li>Mandatory: demonstrated experience working on BFSI brands (banking, insurance, broking, fintech, or investment platforms)</li> <li>Hands-on experience with digital branding campaigns across large-scale, multi-city mandates</li> <li>Prior experience managing clients independently at a senior or leadership level</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Digital Expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven full-funnel media experience: from awareness and consideration (OLV, CTV, Display, Programmatic) through to performance and conversion (SEM, Retargeting, App Install, Lead Generation)</li> <li>Ability to design and execute campaigns that address different funnel stages simultaneously, with distinct KPIs, messaging, and channel logic at each level</li> <li>Deep knowledge of digital partners across OLV, CTV, Programmatic Display, Social (Meta, You Tube), SEM, and Hyperlocal</li> <li>Strong command of cost benchmarks across digital formats and the ability to validate and negotiate partner rates</li> <li>Experience building and reviewing integrated digital media plans with clear rationale for channel mix, budget allocation, and targeting</li> <li>Hands-on involvement in campaign implementation, trafficking coordination, and delivery tracking, not just planning</li> <li>Familiarity with the programmatic ecosystem: DSPs, SSPs, DMPs, brand safety tools, and measurement frameworks</li> <li>Understanding of Brand Lift, Search Lift, and attribution methodologies relevant to BFSI advertisers</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong analytical thinking: ability to read data, identify trends, and translate into strategic action</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present clearly to senior clients</li> <li>High attention to detail in plan documents, trackers, client notes, and presentation decks</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously without compromising quality</li> <li>Strong team player with the ability to manage upward, laterally, and with vendor partners</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Good to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Specific experience on stock broking, mutual fund, or investment platform accounts</li> <li>Exposure to CTV/OTT media buying (Jio Hotstar, Sony LIV, etc.)</li> <li>Familiarity with platforms such as DV360, The Trade Desk, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Ads</li> <li>Awareness of SEBI advertising guidelines and BFSI-specific disclaimer norms</li> <li>Experience in sports marketing, including high-profile sponsorship properties such as IPL: managing linear TV + CTV buys, sponsorship integrations, and delivering reach at scale during live sporting events</li> <li>Experience contributing to award entries or case study development</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</span><span data-contrast="auto"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="Text Run SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="Normal Text Run SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="Text Run SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="Normal Text Run SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div>

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

experienceProfile.rawText: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com . About WPP Media WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com. WPP Media is WPP's global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It's what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media's shared core values: Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. 3 best things about the job: You will be the owner of transforming the agency's digital media buying from “manual” insertion order to data and technology-driven buying, generating higher ROI for clients and higher revenue/margin. It's Programmatic. The world is moving in that direction. You will be charged with driving that for the largest media agency in India working across all the publishers, vendors and start-ups creating disruption to “traditional” way of doing business Working with cross-functional teams to drive efficiently and automation at scale. In this role, your goals will be: In 3 months: Bed down and understand the programmatic setup across the business Build out a roadmap for what is required to grow the programmatic buying business moving forward In 6 months: Participate in business proposals, leading the programmatic element and supporting in group pitches. Ensure that we offer a coordinated and integrated operation with the wider business Isolate new business prospects and help grow revenue for existing clients In 12 months: Establish your position as a thought leader, with demonstrable thought leadership including a deep awareness of programmatic platforms and industry trends. Ensure at least one strategic win by secure the programmatic buying business for one of the key current clients What your day job looks like in WPP Media : Develop strong relationships with counterparts in WPP Media regional teams (Europe, U.S., Asia) Lead the training and growth of your local programmatic team Enforce DV360 and True View best practices with a focus on platform expertise, consistency, and quality of work delivery Be accountable for consistent work delivery to WPP Media regional teams by ensuring a high quality of output Serve as point of escalation for your team and take ownership of resolving challenges Provide career development and coaching for your team Provide timely and actionable feedback to the team to aid in their development, improvement, and progress. Provide awareness and recognition for jobs well done Provide support to capacity planning & resource management for the team Present strong and effective communication across all levels What you'll bring: Working experience in Agency, Trading Desks or Programmatic Tech Partners Actual Campaign execution experience with most of the local programmatic players as well as measurement providers Familiar with DSP and exchange revenue streams and be able to negotiate trading benefits Existing relationships with publishers, programmatic product partners, as well as data providers in the local market Knowledge of different programmatic trading models and their implications to both advertiser's inventory quality and publisher monetization strategies Being able to articulate difficult technical concepts to non-technical people such as explaining lookalike modeling and cookie mapping to the lay person MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: 5+ year's professional experience with digital media preferably within a media agency/trading desk Experience in Google Marketing Platform (DV360, CM, GA360), UAC/App Campaign experience, Experience in top Ad Tech & Mar Tech platforms. Experience in Client Decks, Programmatic Strategy, New Pitches, etc. Hands on experience and knowledge on programmatic platforms. Clear thought process & strategy to build on existing businesses. Competent in all Microsoft office software Life at WPP Media & Benefits Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About WPP Media

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

experienceProfile.rawText: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com . About WPP Media WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com. WPP Media is WPP's global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It's what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media's shared core values: Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Core RESPONSIBILITIES: Have a thorough understanding of the clients' businesses (KPIs, key challenges and how they differ from other brands). Understand the key tools and processes critical to the everyday running of the account. Managing the day to day output of the team with high quality and high responsiveness to client requests Thorough knowledge of the integrated media landscape of brands handled Establish relationship with key clients. Embedded yourself into the internal team and understood the different specialist teams you work with Built a strong, collaborative relationship with your clients, acting as the senior contact across clients. You are expected to have experience in digital strategy, communications planning, digital consultancy and execution wherever possible in an agency environment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

- the largest marketing services group in the world.<br>2. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP &amp; WPP Media’s shared core values:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Be <strong>Extraordinary</strong> by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.&nbsp;</li> <li>Create an <strong>Open </strong>environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.&nbsp;</li> <li>Lead <strong>Optimistically</strong> by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role description:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a 7+ years’ experienced talented and enthusiastic individual to join our WPP team as a<strong> </strong><strong>Planning Director.</strong> This is a Full-time position based in&nbsp;<strong>Mumbai</strong>&nbsp;<strong>.</strong> This role plays a crucial part in supporting WPP's mission to deliver consistency, delivery excellence and diverse businesses.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibility</strong></p> <ul> <li><em>Planning expertise:</em>&nbsp;Own end-to-end planning and execution of Prime Video launch campaigns across premium/mass non-biddable digital platforms. Understand audience targeting, frequency management, and cross-channel coordination principles.</li> </ul> <p>Ability to work on documents/notes along with Business/strategy teams.</p> <ul> <li><em>Execution Excellence</em>: Manage multiple high-priority APV launches simultaneously with strong attention to detail. Track delivery, pacing, inventory utilization, and campaign health during activity period. Proactively identify risks, resolve execution issues and ensure zero missed launch milestones. Support weekend coordination with partners as APV releases happen during weekends.</li> <li><em>Stakeholder management:</em>&nbsp;Build and maintain strong working relationships with premium non-biddable digital partners and OTT publishers. Drive coordination across multiple vendors simultaneously during high-stake launch periods.&nbsp;Act as the primary activation interface between the client, internal business team, investment team and partners.</li> <li><em>Solution oriented:</em>&nbsp;Ability to make decisions and resolve problems quickly and effectively.</li> <li><em>Innovations &amp; ideas:</em>&nbsp;Contribute activation ideas and platform innovations aligned to shows and audience consumption trends. Drive test-and-learn initiatives across premium digital formats and partner ecosystems.</li> <li><em>AI focussed:&nbsp;</em>Contribute to the adoption of AI-enabled media workflows within the team and streamline repetitive activation processes and reduce TAT.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. &nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. About WPP Media WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com. WPP Media is WPP's global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It's what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media's shared core values: Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Role Summary and Impact This role is within the Modelling Services part of the Data, Tech & Analytics team , where you will be instrumental in delivering high-quality analytical and data-driven projects that help drive effective marketing and media planning decisions. Sitting between the WPP Media agency brands and at the intersection of data science, econometric modelling, and client consultancy, you will support the end-to-end delivery of bespoke modelling analytics projects. As a Senior Associate, you will play a key role in delivering analytical support to our clients. Your primary impact will be in managing complex marketing datasets, building robust statistical models (such as market mix models, attribution, and brand health modelling), and translating those outputs into actionable insights. You will work collaboratively with planning teams and clients to ensure these learnings are consistently applied to media planning decisions, fostering a positive, supportive, and continuous-learning environment. Skills and Experience Academic Background and Experience Essential: A bachelor's degree in a highly numerate/quantitative subject (e.g., Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science) or equivalent demonstrable practical experience. Desirable: A master's degree in a numerate/quantitative subject. A second degree in Marketing or Business/Management. Prior work experience (internships or placements) within a marketing, media, or general business environment. Core Technical Skills & Knowledge Essential: Strong understanding of basic statistics and the principles of regression analysis. High level of comfort working with both small and large datasets to discover insights. Efficient use and writing of code-specifically R or Python -to build, update, and run scripts for data processing, analysis, and visualization. High proficiency in Excel (data manipulation, formulas) and Power Point (presentation creation). Knowledge of standard analytical methodologies including Econometrics/MMM, Brand Health modelling, attribution models, and media optimization. Desirable: Understanding of advanced statistical methods. Ability to use SQL, Stata, or SPSS. Core Responsibilities & Professional Attributes Data Processing & Quality Control: Own the creation and validation of project datasets. Run thorough error checks on raw and processed data, proactively query and resolve anomalies with providers, and design/implement automation or efficiency improvements for data ingestion. Robust Modelling & Forecasting: Independently update existing modelling files and build technically sound statistical models under line manager guidance. Know how to balance statistical robustness with intuitive sense, justify all model variables, and use outputs to build and update forecasting and optimization tools (such as curve creation and interpretation). Storytelling & Reporting: Take responsibility for compiling sections of client presentations. Write storytelling, insight-led, and actionable headlines supported by fully formatted and checked charts. Suggest additional content Client Engagement & Meeting Leadership: Play an active role in client meetings, following discussion, taking notes/actions and contributing where relevant Integration & Relationship Building: Act as a key point of contact for internal project, planning, and client teams. Work collaboratively to ensure modelling insights are integrated into media planning decisions, and respond to ad-hoc queries from planners. Leadership, Mentorship & Team Growth: Provide basic guidance and mentorship to junior Analysts in the team. Take responsibility for sharing specialist knowledge and case studies across the wider agency, and work towards completing professional credentials like the IPA Foundation Certificate and continue to broaden and deeper your knowledge of the industry Departmental Contribution & Vision: Active participation in departmental vision working groups, taking responsibility for a key area of focus and suggesting new ways to achieve agency goals. Commercial Awareness: Maintain a strong awareness of project timelines, pricing, resource allocation, and how your personal resource usage impacts the team's commercial profitability. Support project wrap-ups by updating benchmarking databases for cross-brand trend analysis. Life at WPP Media & Benefits Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Senior Director - Commerce
location: Bangalore, India; Gurgaon, India; Mumbai, India
jobDescription:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Role Summary and Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Director - Ecommerce who will:

  • Manage integration of media commerce campaigns with overall mainline & off-platform digital
  • campaign planning & execution.
  • Execute & Track performance of all media commerce campaigns for the client, across search,
  • display, DSP and off-platform performance marketing campaigns.
  • Lead Evangelization of the use of e-commerce across all client media plans & drive early adoption with both internal & external teams.

Skills and Experience

  • Understands the e-commerce ecosystem & business landscape (Marketplace, E-grocers, Hyperlocal platforms etc.)
  • Strong understanding of the digital ad & media platforms like Google, FB, Amazon, etc. – knowledge on capability, metrics & business implication on client’s e-commerce business strategy
  • Ability to leverage industry connects & sources to help achieve the e-commerce targets for the client.
  • Has execution experience & understanding of e-commerce industry ad platforms like Amazon Search, DSP, etc. and strong knowledge of media opportunities that exist on other e-commerce platforms
  • Experience of having managed performance marketing & brand media campaigns on leading ecommerce platforms will be a plus
  • Experience of working in roles such as Category Management/Marketing, Media Monetization, Ecommerce Key Account Management, Business Development & Strategic Alliances

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

jobDescription:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About WPP Media

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.
